name: dr-cockpit
description: A Claude Code mod for long sessions: a cockpit pane of what the session is doing, context against its handoff budget, usage limits with forecasts, subagents, the dr-superpowers run and the repo; Discord notifications when a turn needs you or ends; and a guard that keeps AI attribution out of commits and pull requests.

handoffTokens.title: Handoff budget (tokens)
handoffTokens.description: Context size at which the band says hand off. 0 follows DR_SUPERPOWERS_BUDGET, else dr-superpowers' rule: 93% of the smaller of autoCompactWindow and the model's window, minus 140,000.

nudgeModel.title: Tell the model at the budget
nudgeModel.description: In a session running dr-superpowers, add one note to the conversation when the main session crosses its handoff budget.

guardAttribution.title: Keep AI attribution out of git
guardAttribution.description: Drop the commit trailer and pull request footer Claude Code asks for, and refuse commits and pull requests that still carry AI attribution.

warnAt.title: Warn at (% of the handoff budget)
warnAt.description: Where the strip above the prompt starts showing the handoff reading, as a share of the handoff budget, 1 to 99.

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: auto, full or compact. auto: the full layout docked beside the transcript, the compact strip (dr-status' two framed lines and the buttons) when the pane sits above the prompt. full or compact: always that one. Anything else counts as auto.

sections.title: Pane sections
sections.description: Which sections the full pane shows, in order, comma-separated: account, context, usage, shells, agents, plan, repo, guard. Empty shows all eight.

breakdownRows.title: Context breakdown rows
breakdownRows.description: How many /context categories the Context section lists, largest first, up to 12. 0 hides the breakdown.

openAtStart.title: Open the pane at session start
openAtStart.description: Open the cockpit when a session starts. Claude Code shows it once the terminal is 144 columns wide, 110 once you have opened it before; /cockpit opens it at any width.

limitAlertAt.title: Usage limit alert (%)
limitAlertAt.description: Show a toast once when the 5-hour or 7-day limit crosses this share, again after it resets. 0 turns it off.

notifyOn.title: Discord: events to send
notifyOn.description: Comma-separated: ask, question, done, error, blocked, budget, limit, task, session, agent. Empty sends ask, question, done, error, blocked, budget and limit; none sends nothing. The webhook itself is set in the cockpit's settings view.

notifyAfter.title: Discord: done after (seconds)
notifyAfter.description: A finished turn is sent only when it ran at least this long. 0 sends every turn.

notifyAskAfter.title: Discord: approval after (seconds)
notifyAskAfter.description: An approval or question is sent only when it is still unanswered after this long. 0 sends at once.

notifyDetail.title: Discord: detail
notifyDetail.description: full sends command, question and answer excerpts (secrets masked); brief sends titles and figures only.
